correctness.rationale: Proved over every cyclic ring size n>=3: local XOR identities give exact run erosion and first entry; parity projection of a finite run-counter matrix gives all-size CDF; factorial moments of rare edge patterns give Poisson convergence; geometric tail sums give E T_n=(1/2)log_2 n+O(1). Direct enumeration of 65,528 states and independent integer matrix powers replay successfully. The finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact complete transient census and lattice Poisson extreme-value law solve a natural dynamical hitting-time question on a classical majority automaton. They sharpen prior empirical size-dependence observations to a proved logarithmic scale with coefficient one-half; parity constraints and checkerboard exceptions make the finite-size invariant nontrivial. The full finite-size distribution matters independently of known fixed-point or period-two classifications.
